name: Igarashi Shingo
source:
In-house Attorney

Characteristics: Strict, feel difficult to get closer with women

A resident of the share house. After passing the Bar examination, he worked in an attorney agency and defended the hospital out of his past credit in lawsuit.

"I never said I want you to worry about me."
